sources.title: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B Uncensored: A 35B MoE Model With 262K Context
sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-Uncensored-HauhauCS-Aggressive is an uncensored variant of Qwen's 35B mixture-of-experts language model, maintained by HauhauCS. The model contains 35 billion total parameters with approximately 3 billion active per forward pass through a sparse expert architecture. It features a hybrid attention design combining linear attention with full softmax attention in a 3:1 ...

sources.snippet: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8 Note This repository contains FP8-quantized model weights and configuration files for the post-trained model in the Hugging Face Transformers format. These artifacts are compatible with Hugging Face Transformers, vLLM, SGLang, KTransformers, etc.
